evidence.title: An Agentic Approach for Active Data Collection, Travel Behavior Modeling, and Weather-Sensitive Demand Prediction

summary: A new agentic AI approach enables autonomous data gathering and dynamic modeling of travel behavior, improving accuracy in forecasting demand that varies with weather conditions. The method integrates active learning with domain-specific simulations, offering potential benefits for transportation planning and logistics.
title: Researchers unveil agentic AI framework for active data collection, travel behavior modeling, and weather-sensitive demand prediction
